description: The spec types every PATCH body as io.k8s.apimachinery.pkg.apis.meta.v1.Patch, a bare object, which convert drops, and names the patch types only in `consumes`. Patch operations had no body member, and a patch passed as extra keys went out as application/json, which the API server refuses with 415 Unsupported Media Type (kube-apiserver v1.36.2, 2026-10-29). Each patch operation gets a required `contentType` header that names the patch type, as client-go does, and an optional `patch` document that carries a JSON patch (an array of operations). For the other patch types, scripts/generate.ts adds the resource's own fields to the input, so a merge patch reads like a replace. application/apply-patch+cbor is left out: it needs a body of CBOR bytes.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: How the server applies a PATCH body.
Patch type of the body. application/apply-patch+yaml (server-side apply) needs fieldManager; application/strategic-merge-patch+json works for built-in resources only.
A JSON patch (application/json-patch+json): an array of operations, sent as the whole body. For a merge, strategic merge or apply patch, set the resource fields instead.
